title: Artsclusive
rules:
Round I: Concept Sketch Round

  • One (01) participant per team.
  • The theme will be announced at the commencement of the competition.
  • Participants must create an original hand-drawn poster based on the given theme.
  • The hand-drawn poster will serve as the concept/reference for Round II.
  • No marks will be awarded for the hand-drawn poster.
  • Participants must complete the hand-drawn poster within 30 minutes.

Round II: Digital Poster Design Round

  • Recreate the hand-drawn poster using Canva Free Version only.
  • Use of Canva Pro, premium elements, or paid resources is prohibited.
  • AI image generation is permitted only through Canva Free's built-in AI features. Use of any other AI tools/platforms (e.g., ChatGPT, Leonardo AI, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, etc.) is strictly prohibited.
  • Images from Canva Free and other online sources may be used only as design resources. The final poster must have an original layout, composition, and presentation. Use of pre-designed posters or complete templates/layouts is prohibited.
  • Internet access is permitted only for Canva Free and downloading copyright-free design resources.
  • Personal laptops, mobile phones, tablets, USB drives, smart watches, or other electronic devices are not permitted.
  • Time allotted: 2 hours.
  • Poster size: A4 (8.27 × 11.69 inches). Submit in PNG, JPEG, or PDF format.
  • No modifications will be allowed after submission.
  • The decision of the judges shall be final and binding.
judging:
Creativity and Originality – 20 Marks

Relevance to the Theme – 15 Marks

Replication of the Hand-Drawn Concept – 20 Marks

Visual Appeal and Layout – 15 Marks

Typography and Colour Harmony – 10 Marks

Content and Clarity of Message – 10 Marks

Overall Presentation and Impact – 10 Marks

Total: 100 Marks
